status: Proposed living doctrine; not a membership contract or rank grant

orders.title: The Living Jedi Testament
commitments: Protect the freedom of students to disagree.
orders.oath: I choose awareness over haste, understanding over certainty, and service without possession. I accept responsibility for my actions and remain willing to learn.
orders.leadership: Teachers demonstrate knowledge, patience, accountability and respect for independent judgment.

orders.title: The Sith Flame
orders.tagline: Master yourself, and no throne is necessary.
commitments: Defend personal sovereignty while respecting the sovereignty of others.
orders.oath: I choose to shape my life through deliberate will. I shall examine my passions, confront my limitations and accept the consequences of my choices. My strength shall not require another's captivity.
orders.leadership: Teachers demonstrate competence, discipline, transparency and respect for voluntary participation.
